relations: Clay Aaron Rourke 与妹妹 Jess：Jess 自称 'I’m twenty-two'，Clay 仍回 'You are my baby sister, so you are still twelve'；Jess 喊他 'Clay Aaron Rourke, when are you going to stop?'

Clay 与 Nixie：Clay 说自己是老板唯一信任的两人之一（'the only one our boss trusts besides Nixie'）；Nixie 是 Fear Island 的 operations manager，发邀请、做背景调查、处理合同，并对 Clay 承担母亲角色（Clay 的亲生母亲 'Mine died when Jess was a baby'，Clay 还有 'my other sister'）
Clay 与手下 Kodi、Brooks：Kodi 隔空汇报（'Will do, boss.'）并被 Clay 把 exit reports 交给他；Brooks 奉命护送 Jess 过桥（'Brooks doesn’t like anyone or anything'）
Jess 与她男朋友的前女友：敌对——前女友跟踪两人（'She is stalking us, Clay—she’s everywhere we go'）并威胁炸掉男友的车；Clay 早已掌握男朋友的 'name, age, address, and where every person in his immediate family lives'
Clay 与 Vero、Brawley：'Vero and Brawley are two of the people I am closest to on the island'；Brawley 外号 'The Grim Reaper'、靠暴力行事，Vero 'exudes crackhead energy'；Karo 是扔刀、点火轮的角色（'I tie bad girls to it'）

facts.fact: Kodi 在对讲机里报告抓到一个偷渡上岛的人，Clay 当即下令把人押出去、拍照，并终身禁止其上岛
facts.anchor: “Escort them out and take their picture. They are banned from the island.”

facts.fact: Jess 告诉 Clay：她男朋友的前女友一直在跟踪两人，还威胁要炸掉男友的车（车里坐着他们俩）
facts.anchor: “She is stalking us, Clay—she’s everywhere we go. She even threatened to blow up his car with us inside.”

facts.fact: 在马戏团帐篷里一把刀擦着 Clay 的头飞过，Clay 转身把 Jess 甩到右侧躲开（刀是 Karo 扔的）
facts.anchor: I stop and Jess runs straight into my back, then I pivot and grab Jess around the waist, throwing us to my right as a knife blade sails past my head.

facts.fact: Clay 告诉 Jess 他会处理她前女友的问题，但要求她马上离开
facts.anchor: “I will handle your little ex-girlfriend problem, but you need to leave. Now.”

facts.fact: Jess 央求 Clay 只把那女人吓一吓、不要杀人，免得自己成了共犯
facts.anchor: “But don’t murder her—I don’t want to be an accessory. Just scare her a little. It shouldn’t be hard when your face always looks like that.”

facts.fact: Clay 命 Brooks 把 Jess 送到她的车并看着她过桥，Brooks 直接把她扛上肩带走
facts.anchor: Her words are cut off as Brooks picks her up and tosses her over his shoulder.

facts.fact: Clay 请 Nixie 查那前女友的背景，Nixie 答应当晚给出她的姓名、住址和雇主
facts.anchor: “Consider it done. I will have her name, address, and employer by the end of the night.”

facts.fact: 8:00 p.m. 全员到特技场集合，Nixie 宣布当晚规则：对腕带、读档案、CONSENT IS NOT OPTIONAL（有人喊停就必须停）、划分区域、有人受伤立刻停场
facts.anchor: Third, CONSENT IS NOT OPTIONAL. It’s the only reason we’re not all in prison. The moment someone taps out, you stop.
